name: list_routines
description: List the workout routines saved in the user's openGym profile (the same list the Plan screen shows). Each routine is a named set of exercises with set/rep targets. Use this to discover the plan structure before diving into a specific routine or today's workout.

name: get_routine
description: Get the full exercise list for a single routine (the same view the routine editor shows). Returns mode (reps/time/cardio), set/rep/weight targets (a `pyramid` list of per-set rep targets, 'max' meaning as many reps as possible, when the exercise uses pyramid sets, with `pyramid_rest_sec` and `pyramid_weight` per set where planned, 0 meaning the exercise's rest or last time's weight), superset links, any per-exercise custom increment or Epley deload factor, and each exercise's own rest in seconds (absent means it inherits the global rest timer). Use routine_id from list_routines.

name: preview_session
description: Preview the session a routine will actually open with — the numbers the user will see after the progression policy and their training history have overridden the routine's own targets. This is NOT the same as get_routine: a routine storing "squat 3x8 @ 60kg" can open at 75kg because the policy progressed or deloaded from that routine's last logged session. The reps are the routine's own unless a policy that moves reps moved them, or the profile starts planned sessions from the last session (starts_from). Always call this (not get_routine) before telling someone what weight they are about to lift, or before judging whether an edit to a routine had any effect. Returns, per exercise, the planned target, the policy's decision and its stated reason, the opening set rows, and where each number came from. Defaults to today's scheduled routine.

routine_id.description: Routine to preview. Defaults to the routine scheduled for `date`.

date.description: Date the session would be started on, YYYY-MM-DD. Affects which routine is scheduled and any one-off day override. Defaults to today.

name: get_week_plan
description: Show the user's training plan. `days` is the authoritative answer to "what is planned when": the next seven dates from today with the routines planned for each (a date can hold several — a combined day) and how each was decided: a coach-week session ("coach"), a session the user pinned to that date ("pinned"), a one-off routine override ("override"), a "rest" override ("rest_override"), the weekday plan ("weekday") or nothing ("rest"). `coach_week` is the current coach week when one is running (a week written by an external planner through the API, never by the app): its sessions are done IN ORDER on whatever days the user trains (no weekday attached), the first undone one is today's session, a session can be pinned to a date, and `waiting` means the week starts on `starts_on`. `weekdays` is the user's own weekly plan keyed by JS getDay() (Sunday=0 … Saturday=6, the openGym state convention) — in a coach week it holds only the routines the user planned themselves, which ride along beside the coach-week session.

name: list_workouts
description: List recent finished workouts, newest first. Each item summarises the date, exercise count, sets done / planned, total volume (in the user's unit), duration and whether PRs were set. Use this before drilling into a specific date with get_workout.

from.description: Inclusive start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to no lower bound (list most recent).

to.description: Inclusive end date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Max items to return. Defaults to 25.

name: get_workout
description: Get the full breakdown of one workout: every exercise, its mode (reps/time/cardio), the target, and per-set labels (e.g. "5 @ 60 kg", "1:30 · 20 kg"). Identify it by workout_id (from list_workouts) or by date. Use list_workouts first if you don't know either.

date.description: The workout date as YYYY-MM-DD. If two sessions share that date, the answer lists them instead and asks for a workout_id.

workout_id.description: The id from list_workouts. Preferred: it names one session even on a day with two.

name: get_bodyweight
description: Get the body-weight log: chronological weigh-ins with weights, current goal, deltas vs goal (signed positive = above goal), and a latest summary. Useful for "am I trending toward my weight goal?" questions.

to.description: Inclusive end date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: estimate_1rm
description: Estimate one-rep max using Epley, Brzycki or Lombardi formulas. If an exercise_id is given, returns the all-time best estimate for that exercise with the source set (weight × reps + date) and the trend across history. If no exercise_id is given, returns a PR table across all reps-mode exercises (sorted highest first). Refuses to guess above 12 reps — above that, formulas diverge past 10% and "work capacity" is read instead of "maximal strength".

exercise_id.description: An exercise id from list_routines or get_workout entries. If omitted, returns a full PR table.

formula.description: Formula to use. Defaults to epley.

name: muscle_balance
description: Show which muscles the user has trained in a period, ranked by "effective sets" (volume in kg is intentionally not used — 100 kg leg press vs 12 kg lateral raise say nothing about which muscle worked harder). Reports worked muscles with a 0-4 relative level (1 = some work, 4 = most worked) and the muscles trained zero times in that period — useful for "what am I neglecting?" questions.

period.description: window: last 7 days, last 30 days, or all-time

name: get_programme
description: Includes effortScale and displayDefinition in the profile scale alongside the unchanged authored definition and cycle. Read the active program and its frozen definition, or a specific cycle/definition. Includes the synced revision for conditional actions.

name: programme_position
description: Read program week, next session/date, projected end and done/skipped adherence using the same projection as the UI. Pending dates are derived.

name: activate_programme
description: Activate or adopt a saved validated program using UI guards. Requires explicit write opt-in, a paired API token for this profile and the expected revision. Never replaces an active/paused cycle or a running workout.

name: shift_programme
description: Shift the active program to tomorrow without skipping, through the same UI helper and authenticated conditional API write.

name: skip_programme_session
description: Explicitly skip one pending occurrence. Finished logs win; resolved sessions are refused. Requires write opt-in, profile authentication and the expected revision.

name: validate_program
description: Validate supplied JSON, a local draft, or an HTTP library definition without writing data.

name: create_program_draft
description: Create a personal local draft from scratch, a clone, or canonical/library JSON. No state writes.

name: get_program_draft
description: Return a week summary and conformance; full JSON requires full:true.

name: list_program_drafts
description: List personal draft summaries without full programme JSON.

name: delete_program_draft
description: Delete a draft only at the caller’s expected revision.

name: patch_program_draft
description: Atomically apply typed operations addressed by stable identities.

name: set_slot
description: Set an exercise and/or prescription at a stable slot reference.

name: set_slot_targets
description: Set explicit default/per-set effort targets.

name: set_progression
description: Attach an authored progression to one or more stable slots.

name: set_progression_rule
description: Upsert one closed engine rule and optionally attach it to stable slots. Stall rules attach through onStall. Atomic, revision checked, validated; no state writes.

name: set_program_metadata
description: Edit metadata while retaining personal draft privacy.

name: repeat_week
description: Expand explicit concrete copies with required target/rule retention choices.

name: generate_deload
description: Preview an authored deload; apply only with confirm:true. Factors and effort have no defaults.

name: list_programmes
description: List authenticated library summaries, versions, privacy and active use without full definitions. Large results are capped; continue with nextOffset.

name: diff_programs
description: Compare draft/definition references by stable week, day, session and slot identities, including ordering and conformance changes. Full details require full:true.

name: publish_program_draft
description: Explicitly publish a Ready personal draft to the library only. Dry run defaults true; writing requires dry_run:false, confirm:true, both authoring/write gates, draft revision and current library parent version. Existing library ids also require replace:true.

name: validate_progression
description: Pure progression validation for JSON or a local draft; programme_id reads the authenticated HTTP profile/library. No writes.

name: preview_progression
description: Preview via HTTP, with every prescribed load and summarised Why. full:true includes all inputs and the TM timeline. A draft source uses {draft_id}; no state writes.

name: apply_progression
description: Dry run by default. A write needs dry_run:false, confirm:true, both authoring/write env gates, and confirmNoActiveSession:true from the human. Inventory-adjustment warnings require separate explicit confirmInventoryAdjustment:true; never retry or auto-confirm a 409/422.

name: log_workout
description: Log a past local-date workout; defaults to dry_run:true with the exact record and resolved ids. Explicit dry_run:false plus the programme write env gate commits. Freestyle has no programme effect; never touches an active workout.

name: delete_workout
description: Undo an agent-logged workout with confirm:true and the write env gate. Only unchanged records sealed by this tool can be undone. Refuses server-visible active workouts; phone-local drafts cannot be detected.
